alt: 一對伴侶共撐小傘、一起提著野餐籃，親密地並肩走在公園小路上。
scene_prompt: Two affectionate adult partners walk close together along a park path, gently holding hands and sharing one small umbrella despite only a light drizzle. They lean toward each other with warm mutual smiles; their free hands carry a shared picnic basket together. Clear lasting intimate bond, respectful family-friendly affection, no glue, no paint. Anatomically separate hands and arms.
